findings.R1: Decree 67 speaks of exceeding a Ministry of Health 'normal value'; Art 9(2) permits no alcohol at all; the two fit only if the normal value is endogenous alcohol.
findings.R2: Class letters A1, B1, C, D mean different vehicles before and after 1 January 2025.
findings.R3: The E and former F classes do not name the automobile alone.
findings.R4: No class entitles a special-use automobile above 3,500 kg towing a trailer of up to 750 kg.
findings.R5: A licence with no points is in force but may not be driven under; Decree 67's licence limbs do not name it.
findings.R6: An unexchanged former A1 does not reach motorcycles under 50 cm3 or 4 kW designed above 50 km/h.
findings.R7: Article 34(1)(a) and (g) overlap for a heavy three-wheeler with a moped's motor and speed.
findings.R8: A tractor is a special-use machine, not a motor vehicle, and its operator needs no licence; Decree 67 treats it as both.
findings.R9: Art 40(2) does not provide for every conversion between kinds with a service life; Art 9(10) forbids the plainest (truck to coach), but not a four-wheeled motorised goods vehicle made a passenger one.
findings.R10: The Law fixes no service life in years (Article 40(4)).
findings.R11: Former classes measure by payload, new ones by gross mass; the exchange of 89(3)(e) can lose a vehicle.
findings.R12: A sale is a case for revocation; the seller stays responsible until it is done; an auctioned plate is not revoked.
findings.R13: Art 87(5) gives an endogenous finding for blood only; Art 9(2) and Decree 67 reach breath too, so a breath-tested driver cannot show endogenous alcohol.
findings.R14: A learner drives an automobile lawfully with no licence (Article 56(5)).
findings.R15: Art 2(12): a road traffic accident is a collision; if Decree 67's accident is read through it, harm without a collision is outside.
findings.R16: The Law calls anyone carried 'người được chở' and keeps 'hành khách' for passengers in transport; Decree 67 covers only 'hành khách', so a pillion rider is in neither of its limbs (reading only; supports VN-10 R1).
